annotations.title: Rate history for a truck type

description: Rate per mile for one truck type and its monthly history: national, or for freight leaving or entering one state. Per-mile rates are for a 750-mile haul.

direction.description: With state: freight leaving it (default) or entering it.

months.description: How many of the most recent months to return. Default 24. History starts 2003-12.

state.description: Two-letter code of a lower-48 state, such as TX. Leave out for the national rate.

name: get_rate_history
title: Rate history for a truck type
